answer: Make every unit of paid work carry a pigment bought fresh each epoch: the dye is priced per funding graph, so the tenth identity from one wallet pays ten times the first, and the stain is permanent — auditors spot a whole clone cluster by its shared color at a glance. Work dyed with stale pigment below the ledge earns nothing, and an identity that burns its dye to the nadir must do unpaid verified work to earn more. One honest agent buys one cheap drop; a farm pays a fortune and still wears its own stain.
